parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: The leg of the pliers is a steel component forming one of the two handles and jaws. It is part of the lever mechanism that allows gripping and cutting.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits force from the user's hand to the jaws for gripping or cutting objects.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg, enabling the opening and closing motion of the pliers.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the pliers is the main structural part that includes the pivot joint and connects both legs.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the central hinge and structural support, allowing the two legs to pivot and apply force efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary while allowing the legs to rotate around its pivot axis.
